fact: On 26 February 2024 the Ministry of Local Government's digital transformation project manager met a telecom company to discuss implementing a secure government network for the ministry and local administration sectors, gathering requirements before drawing up a general network design.
title: وزارة الحكم المحلي تبحث متطلبات تنفيذ مشروع الشبكة الحكومية الآمنة
